It also computes intrinsic VGS=V(q:5)-V(q:9) and VDS=V(q:13)-V(q:9) (windowed and full trace), V(src)/V(drain) package extrema, and a cross-check of v(q:5),v(q:9),v(q:13) ranges against internal_analysis.json. The script emits both the contract's sign orientation and the opposite orientation of each pair, because a closed inductor satisfies v*i=d/dt(.5*L*i^2) either way and probe-label vs pin direction cannot be settled from probe text; disagreement is attributed to a non-L branch, coarse trapezoid integration at a narrow event, or an orientation/name mismatch, never to device physics. Caveat recorded in output: a gross trace containing the extremely narrow reverse-drive event near 1.052us can defeat a trapezoid sum over saved points, so identity failure may reflect coarse integration rather than physics, and identity success would not certify the model. No model edited (st.lib left byte-identical and unreadable-as-UTF-8; hashed at run time), no simulation added, no acceptance threshold changed, no HOLD altered, nothing written outside OUTPUT_DIR. startup_path_audit.notes: Code-only evidence delivery; zero shell/jobs/simulator/network/model calls. Delivered inventory.md (fact table with TPS2660.txt line citations) and startup_arith.py (141 lines, numpy arithmetic, NOT executed -- principal runs it). Key facts sourced verbatim: U101 TPS26601 MODE=OPEN is an electronic circuit breaker with latch-off (TPS2660.txt L170, L1412-L1413, L1717-L1719; latch reset only by SHDN or POR, L276), NOT continuous current limiting; MODE=402kohm to RTN is instead ACTIVE current limiting with latch-off (L554-L555, L1426-L1430) and MODE shorted to RTN is limiting WITH auto-retry -- three distinct behaviours. Guaranteed MIN/MAX limits exist only for GAIN(dVdT) 23.75/25.5 V/V (L453), I(OL)@12k 0.95/1.05 A (L461), I(CB)@120k MODE-open 0.045/0.11 A (L478), I(CB)@5.36k 2.0/2.4 A (L480), V(REVTH) -15/-5 mV (L530). The delays are TYPICAL-ONLY with NO published maximum: tCB(dly) 4 ms (L642), tFASTRIP(dly) 250 ns (L615), tCBretry(dly) 540 ms (L644), tdVdT 10 ms at 47 nF and 23.9 V/1.6 ms with dVdT open (L635-L636, L1365); therefore no max delay is claimed anywhere in this delivery. Arithmetic (to be computed by the principal, not hand-computed here): worst-case dVdT slew rate = Imax*Gmax/Cmin with Imax 5.5u, Gmax 25.5, Cmin 42.3n, giving the 0->26.4 V rise; V(dVdT)=Gmax*1 V (V(ILIM)=1 V, L457); the 10 mA sink absolute max (L309) is carried as a separate limit, not as a delay. Permanence check: for a fixed 33 ohm series element the maximum power transferable is Pmax=Vin^2/(4R), computed for nominal 33 ohm and the -5%/+5% corners and expressed as a percentage of the required 6 W; the resistance that would actually pass 6 W at 26.4 V is 0.5 ohm, so a permanent 33 ohm resistor cannot supply 6 W and the bypass MUST close. Route comparison: (A) permanent series R with eFuse MODE=open CB+latch, versus (B) independent precharge plus a bypass closed only when |Vin-Vout|<=1 V with PWM disabled -- B has NO hardware, NO bypass model and NO claimed maximum delay; it is a proposal only.
